sunpak - led 448 19\" bi-color ring ligh.name: Sunpak - LED 448 19" Bi-Color Ring Light Kit - Black
sunpak - led 448 19\" bi-color ring ligh.description: The Sunpak 19” Bi-Color Ring Light Vlogging Kit designed for the Vlogging enthusiast using smartphones or compact cameras. The kit comes with a 19-inch bi-color LED ring light, ball head, adjustable reverse-folding light stand which extends to 70 inches high as well as a smartphone mount to enable you to get the perfect videos from any angle. The powerful 19 inch bi-color LED ring light provides illumination from 100% down to 10%, has color-corrected light for indoor use and is powered by an included AC adapter. The ring light produces three Color Temperature settings from Warm (Tungsten), White (Daylight) and Warm-White (combination of both). Use the Warm lighting setting to deliver colors more accurately than daylight under ordinary household incandescent lighting. You can also add a mixture of Daylight and Tungsten lighting for color temperatures that are variable from 2700°K to 5500°K or in between to meet ambient light requirements, match other fixtures, or just for artistic expression. The ball head allows you to mount a camera, camcorder or any other device with a ¼”-20 threaded mount weighing up to 3 lb. quickly and easily via the included ball head. With the design of the ball head, you can position your camera in any direction securely. You also can use a smartphone with the ring light. The smartphone mount can support phones up to 3.5 inches wide and can be used in portrait or landscape modes, when used in conjunction with the ball head for complete Vlogging ability. Set up the perfect photo shoot or video production from your smartphone with the included Bluetooth remote. A 30-foot range for the Bluetooth-powered remote lets you take the perfect selfie pictures or videos from a distance. The remote connects to any Apple or Android device without the need of any app or other software. You can take pictures or start and stop your videos remotely with simply the press of a button.
